ranges.quote: Bots can hammer a sign-up form thousands of times a second. Fake accounts, spam, credential stuffing. You need to tell humans apart from scripts without annoying real users.
The first line of defense is invisible. Behavioral signals, how your mouse moves, timing between keystrokes, browser fingerprint. Bots move in suspiciously perfect lines.
